description: What is the Medicare IPPS hospital wage index for a metro area (CBSA) and fiscal year? Returns the wage index CMS applies to hospital inpatient payment in a CBSA, with the GAF, the reclassified wage index, the value before frontier / rural-floor / imputed-floor adjustment, and which floors applied. Answers "Medicare hospital wage index for Boston FY2025", "hospital wage index CBSA 14454 FY2025", "IPPS wage index for Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim", "wage index New York-Jersey City-White Plains FY2026", "rural wage index for Alabama". Pass cbsa (5-digit metro code, or the 2-digit state code for a statewide rural area) and/or area (a metro name, "Boston" or "Boston, MA") and/or state; fiscal_year (FY2022-FY2027 loaded) defaults to the newest and is stated. A CBSA that spans states can carry a different wage index per state, so the per-state rows are always returned. An unmatched CBSA returns found:false, never a nearby area. This is the hospital inpatient wage index, not the physician GPCI (medicare_gpci_lookup) or the FQHC GAF (medicare_fqhc_gaf). Sourced from the CMS IPPS final-rule wage index tables.

area.description: Metro area name or part of it ("Boston", "Los Angeles", "Boston, MA"). The part after a comma is read as the state.

cbsa.description: CBSA code, e.g. "14454" (Boston) or "31084" (Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale; the retired code 31080 returns its successors 31084 and 11244); a 2-digit state code (e.g. "01") selects that state's rural area.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year, e.g. 2025. Omit for the newest loaded year (stated in the response).

state.description: Optional state code or name; alone, lists every CBSA with a row in that state.

name: medicare_hospital_wage_index
title: Medicare Hospital Wage Index
